content.rendered: Topline statistics and party registration statistics are from PDI, which collects data from California counties. PDI tends to run about one day behind state reporting. PDI does not break out mail ballots and in-person votes, whereas the California Secretary of State does. The party registration statistics on mail ballots thus includes in-person votes and exceeds the mail ballot reported by the California Secretary of State.
